question: Seven boxes A, B, C, D, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. No box is kept above F. Only three boxes are kept between F and E. Only one box is kept between C and A. A is kept immediately above E. Only four boxes are kept between C and B. D is kept at some place above G. How many boxes are kept between F and G?
solution:
Seven boxes A, B, C, D, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• No box is kept above F.
 
• Only three boxes are kept between F and E.
 
• Only one box is kept between C and A.
 
• A is kept immediately above E.
 
• Only four boxes are kept between C and B.
 
• D is kept at some place above G
